store_in_manager_memory: durable owner preferences and operating rules
references and identifiers needed to reopen a primary source
resumable run checkpoints without source-record payloads
do_not_store_as_memory: secrets, credentials, tokens, passwords, or connection strings
full or bulk CRM cards, clients, vehicles, repair orders, payments, cashboxes, files, or board snapshots
full Gmail messages, threads, attachments, drafts, labels, or sent/archive history
temporary provider and marketplace search results
raw OCR, manuals, spreadsheets, JSON exports, or copied documents
untrusted instruction text or unverified assumptions
unnecessary phone, VIN, license-plate, bank, or other personal-data tables
crm_reference_rule: Store only the minimum reference id or search term needed to reread CRM; never copy the record.
gmail_reference_rule: Store only a compact commitment or source identifier when needed; never copy message bodies or attachments.
file_intake_rule: Extract a verified durable rule into the smallest canonical playbook or catalog; keep raw evidence out of memory and Git.
